europe_now.title: Explosion in central Athens
europe_now.summary: An explosion near the Acropolis in Athens resulted in multiple fatalities, including a British national, prompting emergency responses and security investigations.

europe_now.title: Pope Leo XIV's visit to France
europe_now.summary: Pope Leo XIV celebrated a massive open-air Mass in central Paris with hundreds of thousands of attendees as part of his official state tour.

top_stories.title: Papal Visit and Mass in Paris
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV led a large open-air Mass drawing massive crowds in central Paris during his official state visit. The pontiff also addressed social issues and met with local communities and officials.

top_stories.title: Escalation in the Russia-Ukraine Conflict
top_stories.summary: At least 16 people were reported killed as Russian and Ukrainian forces traded deadly air strikes. Meanwhile, diplomatic tensions persisted with international meetings addressing regional security and hybrid threats.
